messages:
amanda: @support quick escalation — customer ACME seeing repeated tail latency spikes and occasional 400s from our embeddings endpoint since ~08:10 UTC. They send mixed-dimension payloads (512 and 1536) and suspect batching is the culprit. Logs attached.

support-bot: New escalation created: #INC-12345 (priority: high) :rotating_light:

ryan: looking. which model and route exactly?

amanda: route: POST /v1/embeddings (open-embed-1536), max_batch_size: 64, dynamic batching enabled. Customer note: many small 1-item requests (512 dim) are being coalesced with large 1536-dim requests. When that happens we see either a tail latency jump (500-1200ms) or a 400 with "dim mismatch". They provided a short repro.

sam: can you paste their sample request and the error log here?

amanda: sure — sample payload (redacted):

```
POST /v1/embeddings
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>

{
  "model": "open-embed-1536",
  "input": [[0.12, 0.23, ...]]  // client says some clients send 512-length vectors, some 1536
}
```

Log snippet they attached:

```
[08:12:03.421] batcher: coalesced 14 reqs (window=12ms) dims=[1536,512,1536,...]
[08:12:03.422] serving: ERROR embedding shard-7: expected dim=1536 got=512 -> returning 400 to client xyz
[08:12:03.422] metrics: tail_latency_ms=1123
```

ryan: that log looks like the dyn-batcher merged requests across dims. We should otherwise bucket by embedding_dim. Do we have a config toggle for cross-dim coalescing?

sam: checking current config on route:

```
{
  "route": "/v1/embeddings",
  "model": "open-embed-1536",
  "dynamic_batching": true,
  "max_batch_size": 64,
  "coalesce_by_dim": false,
  "coalesce_window_ms": 15
}
```

sam: confirmed. coalesce_by_dim is false — that allows mixing dims which will rely on runtime padding/trim. Looks like our padding path doesn't handle smaller vs larger dim mixes gracefully for some model variants (or it's returning 400 when trim is attempted).

ryan: I can repro locally. Quick loadgen steps:

```
# send a small 512-dim request
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"open-embed-1536","input":[[...512 numbers...]]}' &
# within 10ms send a 1536-dim request
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"open-embed-1536","input":[[...1536 numbers...]]}'
```

Observed: coalesced in same batch -> one request fails with 400 and batch latency spikes.

infra-bot: Deployed batcher v2.4.1 to prod on 2026-03-17T08:23:12Z (rollout id: r-8501).

sam: root cause hypothesis: dynamic batcher with coalesce_by_dim=false allows mixing dims; the pad/trim path for this model family has an edge-case when receiving mixed dims in the same batch (race between kv-cache alignment and pad vector allocation). Patch in-flight to enforce per-dim buckets inside the coalescer.

ryan: immediate mitigation we recommended to ACME and applied for them remotely:
1) set max_batch_size to 16 for the embeddings route
2) set coalesce_by_dim = true OR temporarily disable dynamic_batching

admin API update example we sent:

```
PATCH /admin/routes/embeddings
{
  "max_batch_size": 16,
  "coalesce_by_dim": true
}
```

amanda: customer applied max_batch_size=16 + coalesce_by_dim=true at 08:40 UTC. After ~20m they reported ~80% reduction in tail latency and zero 400s in that window :thumbsup:

sam: good. I'll open PR to change default behavior: coalesce_by_dim should be true for any embeddings route unless explicitly opted out. Plan to backport the safety check to 2.4.x branch and roll a canary tomorrow.

ryan: plan-of-action:
- PR with fix and unit tests (sam)
- backport to 2.4.x and small canary on dedicated cluster (ryan)
- communicate recommended mitigations to support docs (amanda)
- create a postmortem if we see regression after rollout

amanda: noted — I'll message ACME with the mitigation steps and ETA for permanent fix. Also asked them to share a redactable sample payload if we need deeper debug.

support-bot: Escalation #INC-12345 updated: mitigation applied, monitoring. Assigned to sam/ryan.

ryan: short-term checklist for support engineers:
- If customer reports tail spikes on embeddings, check route config for coalesce_by_dim and max_batch_size.
- Suggest coalesce_by_dim=true or max_batch_size<=16 as quick mitigations.
- Collect one example request pair (512 and 1536) and trace logs.

amanda: thanks team. keeping this thread open until patch is canaried and deployed to hosted.

sam: will follow up with PR link and canary results here.

amanda: thank you :heart:
